name: George T. Sullivan
summary: The eldest of the five Sullivan brothers of Waterloo, Iowa, who enlisted together after a friend was lost at Pearl Harbor on the condition that they serve on the same ship, and were assigned to the light cruiser *Juneau*. She was torpedoed off Guadalcanal on 13 November 1942 and blew up; four brothers died at once and George, the last, survived several days in the water. Their mother was told by a letter that arrived with no notification of which sons. The Navy's later sole-survivor policy, and its reluctance ever again to berth brothers together, dates from them.
